# Social Content Production

## Workflow
1. Verify the brief and approved facts. Separate sourced facts from creative suggestions.
2. Generate three distinct hooks and choose the clearest one for the audience and objective.
3. Draft content in the requested platform format and voice.
4. For carousels, specify each slide's headline, body, visual direction, and final CTA.
5. For short videos, provide hook, spoken script, scene timing, on-screen text, visual cues, captions, and end CTA.
6. For image prompts, specify composition, aspect ratio, hierarchy, palette, typography guidance, safe margins, and prohibited elements.
7. Provide caption, relevant keywords/hashtags where useful, alt text, and a clean filename.
8. Run the quality checklist before marking content ready.

## Quality checklist
- One clear message and one primary CTA.
- Mobile-first readability and platform-appropriate dimensions.
- No unsupported claims, fake quotes, copied competitor creative, or misleading results.
- Preserve supplied identity and official brand assets; do not invent a logo when an official file is required.
- Check spelling, names, dates, links, disclosures, and text-safe margins.
- Follow applicable platform rules and client policy for AI-generated or edited media.
